methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN General Assembly RSS maps to the UN News "UN Affairs" topic feed (news.un.org), an RSS 2.0 feed covering the General Assembly, Secretariat and broader institutional business of the United Nations — reform, budget, appointments, sessions and inter-organ affairs. Note the feed is UN-affairs scoped, slightly broader than the General Assembly alone.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL scopes content to UN affairs on the server side; any finer keyword match (an organ, resolution theme or official) must be applied in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Topic scoping to UN affairs is fixed by the feed URL. Beyond that only client-side filters apply: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no per-item `<category>`/`dc:subject` tags, so no secondary category filter is available.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML article page. Each item also has an `<enclosure>` pointing to a JPEG lead image, not a PDF; no direct document downloads are offered.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~30 items; no historical pagination beyond the feed window and no archive parameter.
